summary: Journalism student with experience reporting, writing, producing and broadcasting sports and local news across print, digital, television and radio platforms. Experienced in live, deadline-driven production, multimedia storytelling, on-air reporting and newsroom collaboration.

degrees: Bachelor of Arts in Journalism, Class of 2027
Bachelor of Arts in European and Russian History, Class of 2027

roles.title: Producer
bullets: Produce a weekly live, deadline-driven 30-minute newscast, using iNews to organize and sequence broadcast content.
Write and select news, weather and sports programming for the broadcast.
Produce website content in WordPress using reporter stories and relevant national news.
Communicate with reporters through weekly pitch meetings to develop stories, plan coverage and meet deadlines.

roles.title: Sports Reporter
bullets: Research, report and produce video packages and articles on local sports stories.
Collaborate daily with reporters, producers and editors to plan and execute newsroom coverage.

roles.title: Radio Broadcasting Intern
bullets: Worked across Sinclair Communications' five-station radio network with a focus on sports broadcasting and on-air production.
Produced daily one-minute sports news segments for News Talk 790-WNIS.
Voiced advertisements and appeared on air with Tony Macrini to discuss news, sports and talk-radio topics.
Appeared several times on the weekly Sports Insight 790 program.

roles.title: Freelance Sports Reporter
bullets: Report and write game recaps covering local athletics for a weekly, family-owned newspaper serving the Rockbridge area.
Collaborate with Sports Editor Jonathan Schwab on story planning and coverage.

roles.title: Play-by-Play, Color & Sideline Reporter
bullets: Analyze and comment on Washington and Lee home athletic events for live broadcast audiences.
Covered NCAA Division III soccer and basketball championship tournaments.

roles.title: Sports Reporter
bullets: Report and write articles covering Washington and Lee athletics for print and digital platforms.

roles.title: Radio Host
bullets: Host live radio programming, manage on-air segments and cultivate an engaging on-air presence and vocal delivery.

roles.title: Student Assistant / Multimedia Content
bullets: Support athletics communications and multimedia coverage through content production and event coverage.

roles.title: Writing Consultant
bullets: Guide students in developing effective writing and presentation skills across academic disciplines.

roles.title: Correspondent
bullets: Gained experience in professional journalism practices and industry networking.
